pairs.subject: migrations
pairs.evidence: src/stores/projectStore.ts:285 The Zustand persist configuration lacks a schema version ledger and migration function, relying instead on unversioned rehydration and ad-hoc mutations across releases.

techniques.evidence: src/stores/navigationStore.ts:94 Persist configuration omits a version ledger and migration steps, providing no ordered chain of idempotent transitions for schema evolution.
src/stores/moduleStore.ts:430 Rehydration mutates persisted state in place without taking a pre-migration snapshot or backup of the localStorage store.
src/stores/moduleStore.ts:436 Rehydration updates fields through direct non-transactional property mutations without an atomic commit or rollback unit.
src/stores/moduleStore.ts:38 Reading the persisted project path catches all exceptions and silently returns null, advancing progressAdopted to true with a null owner.
src/stores/moduleStore.ts:63 Legacy unowned progress is classified by negative elimination rather than a positive signature or atomic store version marker.
src/stores/projectStore.ts:287 Persisted properties are sliced into storage without any boot-time fingerprint assertion or schema drift verification.
src/stores/moduleStore.ts:431 The progress backfill to the active project is fused directly into rehydration lifecycle without batching or escrow.
src/stores/projectStore.ts:286 The store runs in single-process client localStorage where rolling two-version deployment does not apply.
src/stores/moduleStore.ts:415 The persist key is statically declared rather than an operator-defined dynamic table set discovered at runtime.

pairs.registryProposal: Client-side web stores using browser localStorage (e.g. Zustand persist) represent an atomic JSON document store where version markers and state serialize together in a single key; failure modes typically stem from omitted version/migrate options and silent rehydration merges rather than split-write crash windows.

declined.subject: migrations
declined.reason: The save-system context comprises React UI components and mock visualization data for Unreal Engine USaveGame schema design, rather than an operational persistent storage layer executing schema migrations in place.
